views.looks_at: Blackwell and Rubin revenue opportunity in calendar 2026
views.question: Will NVIDIA's Blackwell and Rubin revenue opportunity in calendar 2026 exceed $500 billion?

rungs.label: bullish
rungs.condition: More than $500 billion and up to $600 billion

rungs.label: bearish
rungs.condition: More than $400 billion and less than $500 billion

views.question: Will NVIDIA commence Vera Rubin production shipments by December 31, 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences Vera Rubin production shipments on or before 2026-12-31

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA has not commenced Vera Rubin production shipments by 2026-12-31

views.looks_at: NVIDIA's disclosure at GTC of its Grok low-latency decoder plans
views.question: Will NVIDIA publicly share details of its Grok low-latency decoder plans at GTC on March 16, 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA publicly shares details of its Grok low-latency decoder plans at GTC on 2026-03-16

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA does not publicly share those details at GTC on 2026-03-16
